description: Free, no key needed: a recent, well-sourced quorum, in the exact shape search_quorums returns. A quorum is one news story split into the distinct viewpoints being expressed about it: each viewpoint has a label, a summary and a support_count of the posts behind it, split into media, socials and iwitness (on-the-ground reports). Use it to see the data before paying.
name: sample_quorum
title: Sample quorum (free)
